description: Gathers eight separate signals into one polyphonic cable of eight channels

inputs.text: Becomes the polyphonic channel of that number at the output

outputs.text: Carries all eight inputs as one eight-channel polyphonic signal

notes: an input left empty below a patched one takes a channel of the output all the same, and that channel carries 0V
menu: Channels Merge — sets how many channels the output carries: Automatic, the default, gives as many channels as the highest-numbered patched input, or choose a fixed count from 1 to 8
